# shopify_standard_metaobject_definition (Resource)

Enables one of Shopify's standard metaobject definitions (a `shopify--…` type such as `shopify--material`) from its template. Shopify sets the name, fields, access and capabilities; read them with the `shopify_metaobject_definition` data source. A type that is already enabled is adopted as it is. Destroy only removes the resource from state: deleting the definition would delete every entry in it, so turn it off in the admin if needed. Import with the type, such as `shopify--material`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Enables Shopify's "Material" template; an already-enabled type is adopted.
resource "shopify_standard_metaobject_definition" "material" {
  type = "shopify--material"
}

# Name, fields and access come from the template; read them with the data source.
data "shopify_metaobject_definition" "material" {
  type = shopify_standard_metaobject_definition.material.type
}

# Destroy only removes the definition from state; its entries stay.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Type of the standard template, such as `shopify--material`. Changing it enables the new type and leaves the old one enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Metaobject definition GID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <type>
terraform import shopify_standard_metaobject_definition.material shopify--material
```
